name: Staff of Twin Blossoms procs Blossoming growth on direct damage and healing spells (#10712)
contract: Staff of Twin Blossoms 515201 (item_template spellid_1 202827, on equip) never procced. Blossoming growth Dummy proc 202827 reads 'Your direct damage and healing spells have a chance to increase your haste rating by 30.': aura 42 triggering Blossoming growth 202826 (haste rating +30), DBC ProcChance 10 and ProcFlags 0, and the world had no spell_proc row, so the aura never registered a proc handler.

Expected: the loaded proc entry carries the DBC 10% chance, and a landed direct magic damage spell (Frostbolt 116) and a landed direct heal (Greater Heal 2050) each proc the equipped aura at about 10%. A periodic tick is not a proc event (the tooltip says direct). Before the repair the aura has no proc entry, so the chance lookup fails and every rate reads 0.
An unequipped control carries no proc aura.
